run_prepare_data: run the prepare_data script to sample documents from the rahular/varta dataset for a given language
create_multilingual_dataset: create a multilingual dataset by filtering the varta dataset for a specific language code and saving headlines and text
sample_documents_by_language: sample a specified number of documents from the varta dataset filtered by language code into a text file
review_main_function: review the main function that loads a streaming dataset, filters by language, and writes documents to a text file
refactor_main_for_custom_dataset: refactor the main function to accept a custom dataset name instead of the hardcoded rahular/varta dataset
